imageAlt: HyperChat — Your stream. Their voice. A shared moment. Live creator interactions through text, voice, sound and media.

/.title: HyperChat — Live interactions for creators
/.description: Bring your audience into the stream with HyperChat. Explore text, text-to-speech, recorded voice, sounds and media, with creator-led moderation.

/features.title: HyperChat Features — Voice, alerts & moderation
/features.description: Explore HyperChat’s interactive previews: viewer messages, TTS, recorded voice, soundboard, images, GIFs, moderation and OBS alerts.

/creators.title: HyperChat for Creators — Fees, payouts & onboarding
/creators.description: Explore HyperChat creator onboarding, an 11% platform fee, monthly payouts and international payments. Learn about the planned V2 application process.

/company.title: About HyperChat — Streamheart Private Limited
/company.description: Meet HyperChat, a live creator interaction platform by Streamheart Private Limited, a DPIIT-recognised startup. Discover our partners and support.

/support.title: HyperChat Support — OBS, audio & interaction help
/support.description: Find help with HyperChat OBS alerts, audio, text-to-speech, recorded voice messages and moderation. Contact the team at ankit@hyperchat.space.

/privacy-policy.title: HyperChat Privacy Policy
/privacy-policy.description: Read how Streamheart Private Limited handles personal data for HyperChat, including creator verification, interactions, retention and privacy requests.

/terms-and-conditions.title: HyperChat Creator Terms
/terms-and-conditions.description: Read the terms for HyperChat creators, including eligibility, onboarding, interaction moderation, platform rules, fees and settlement conditions.

/viewer-terms.title: HyperChat Viewer Interaction Terms
/viewer-terms.description: Read the terms for viewers sending HyperChat interactions, including content responsibilities, creator moderation, payment and delivery conditions.

/cancellation-refunds.title: HyperChat Refund & Cancellation Policy
/cancellation-refunds.description: Read HyperChat’s cancellation and refund policy for paid interactions, including delivery issues, moderation decisions and how to request help.

/demo-signup.title: HyperChat — Signup preview
/demo-signup.description: Explore the HyperChat signup design preview. This local demonstration does not create an account or submit an application.
